findings.summary: The new test asserts `finding_count >= 1`, which is nearly vacuous — it would pass even if dedup were completely broken (5 findings in, 5 out). The real verification is the following `ids.count("sonarr-importblocked-D9") == 1` line, which does correctly fail without dedup. Tightening the count assertion to `== 2` would make the test directly assert the guarantee rather than relying on a second line to catch regressions.
